title: someone who isn't selling yet finds the way in

criteria.text: `/you` has no "vendor", "market" or "business owner" and queries none of the dead tables
criteria.note: [V] src/app/you/page.tsx and what it renders (OwnPages, YouNotices, ZipChange, YouInterests, SearchSharingSwitch, SignOutButton, the Following row) contain none of the three words and query only members, member_notices, member_interests, the market_name function and the follows reader (grep 2026-10-23); #895 removed the Default metro row and #911 and #966 added rows, none bringing a word or a dead table back. Built in #379 (review-skipped); deploy-health green on 9ff415f and on every later /you merge (4b9558a, 43bcf96). Smoked: /you opened green by smoke-live on 2026-10-19, 21, 22 and 23 (cb892a7). No standing guard, ticket #582

criteria.text: A Member with no Page sees no shop controls, only their own stuff and one invitation
criteria.note: [V] built half: no shop controls on /you (OwnPages shows a card per Page, the Zip row shows the area, nothing says shop). Missing: the invitation; with no Page the empty state is one line, 'You haven't made a Page yet. Tap Create to start one.', and 'Start something' is a link in the Your Pages header (OwnPages.tsx, you/page.tsx). #15 (T125) was closed on 2026-10-18 as 'nothing left to build' because the Start something row exists; the invitation it names was never built, so it is refiled. The copy is Don's

criteria.text: The invitation names specific maker categories, with one worked example
criteria.note: [V] grep 'maker' in src/app/you and src/components/member finds nothing; no worked example anywhere on You. New user-facing copy, so the wording goes to Don (PM queue). Filed with criterion 2; #15 was closed 2026-10-18 without it

criteria.text: A Member with Pages sees a row per Page with an Edit control and create controls, reusing the existing query
criteria.note: [V] built half: a card per Page, live or unfinished, with Continue and Delete on drafts and 'Start something' above (OwnPages, getOwnPages; #424, #516). Missing: an Edit control on the row; today the owner opens the Page and edits from there. 'Edit shop' is old wording, nouns.md says Page. #15 was closed 2026-10-18 without it

criteria.text: A Member with Pages sees their listings on You
criteria.note: [V] 'listings' is the vendor-era Items noun (#177: /you/sell still writes Items); the 2026-10-01 ruling on You (#303: private, for the Pages you manage, the Pages you follow, your name and area) names what You holds and listings are not in it, and a Page's products and services now live on the Page itself (#909, #920). Cannot tell what the criterion asks for on today's model: routed to scope-scenario

criteria.text: `/following` redirects to `/you/following`; sign-out and follow list as shipped
criteria.note: [V] redirect in next.config.ts (direct commit f6b84e0, 2026-09-10, no PR and no deploy-health run); the follow list was rebuilt in #966 (2026-10-19, Reviewed by: Claude, deploy-health green on 43bcf96): /you/following lists Pages with Unfollow and Undo, people and venues below, all through getMemberFollows; the old src/app/following page is deleted, so the redirect is the only path. SignOutButton on /you. Smoked: /following, /you and /you/following opened green by smoke-live on 2026-10-19 (cd913c7, after #966). unmarked: tests/retired-routes.test.ts ('/following redirects to the shipped /you/following'), you-following-row.test.tsx, FollowedPagesList.test.tsx ('unfollows with Undo'); no test of sign-out
